anime.title: Solo Leveling
anime.description: Sung Jin-Woo, the weakest hunter alive, gains a mysterious power after surviving a deadly double dungeon. He becomes the only player who can level up in a world where no one else can grow stronger, embarking on an epic journey to become the world's greatest hunter.

anime.title: Demon Slayer
anime.description: Tanjiro Kamado's peaceful life is shattered when demons slaughter his family. His sister Nezuko survives but is transformed into a demon. Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure and avenge his family, facing increasingly powerful enemies in breathtaking battles.

anime.title: Death Note
anime.description: Light Yagami, a brilliant high school student, stumbles upon a mysterious notebook that grants him the power to kill anyone whose name and face he knows. Intending to cleanse the world of evil, Light assumes the identity of 'Kira' and sparks a tense global battle of wits against the enigmatic detective known as 'L'.

movies.title: Your Name
movies.description: Two strangers find themselves linked in a bizarre way — a Tokyo boy and a rural girl swap bodies intermittently. As they begin to unravel the mystery, they discover a deeper connection that transcends time and space in this visually stunning romantic fantasy.

movies.title: Suzume
movies.description: A modern action-adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close supernatural doors that are causing disasters across Japan.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.description: Teenager Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join forces with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all reality.
movies.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Mugen Train
movies.description: Tanjiro and his friends join the Flame Hashira Rengoku on the Mugen Train. They face a powerful demon who has been sending the train's passengers into deep sleep, draining their life force in one of the most iconic battles in anime history.
